name: Inner Solar System Diagram
description:
Create a scientific diagram of the inner solar system in ActivInspire.

Your task:
1. Create a new flipchart.
2. Draw a large circle on the left representing the **Sun**. Fill it with **Yellow** color and label it "Sun".
3. Draw four smaller circles to the right of the Sun representing the terrestrial planets. Label them in order: **Mercury**, **Venus**, **Earth**, **Mars**.
4. Draw a line or arrow between the Sun and Earth to represent the distance.
5. Add a text label "**1 AU**" near this line to define the Astronomical Unit.
6. Save the flipchart to `/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/inner_solar_system.flipchart`.

Note: Use the Shape tool for planets and the Sun. Use the Fill tool (bucket) to color the Sun yellow. Use the Text tool for labels.
